requirement.original: Right-side Bash popup — command text (e.g. "$ ls /root/docs/dev/ba-spec-...") overflows the popup horizontal bounds. Horizontal scroll is declared but not effective due to flexWrap+flex:1. The command must stay inside the popup at all popup widths (desktop / narrow desktop / tablet / mobile). Acceptable solutions: horizontal scroll that actually works, soft-wrap at word boundaries, or responsive truncation with view-full affordance. This is spec §5.3.
requirement.clarified: In CommandView.tsx, the command-line row (styles.line) uses flexWrap:'wrap' + commandText uses flex:1, which prevents the outer horizontal ScrollView from measuring scroll content width correctly. Fix: remove flexWrap:'wrap' from the line style and remove flex:1 from commandText in CommandView.tsx. Additionally, add a horizontal ScrollView wrapper around CommandView in the CodexBashView bash/unknown branch (§5.6 propagation).
requirement.what: Remove flexWrap and flex:1 from CommandView.tsx command-line row to allow horizontal ScrollView to work correctly. Add ScrollView wrapper in CodexBashView bash branch.
requirement.why: Long command text overflows the right-side popup frame visually because the ScrollView cannot measure content width wider than the container when flex:1+flexWrap:wrap are set on the child.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Command text in right-side Bash popup (SidebarBashView) overflows the popup's right edge; horizontal scroll declared on the wrapping ScrollView does not function.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: CommandView.tsx line 45: flexWrap:'wrap' + line 59: commandText flex:1. In React Native, flex:1 on a Text inside a flex row resolves against the parent row's BOUNDED width (the popup frame width). The Text then occupies exactly that width and wraps at that boundary. The horizontal ScrollView never measures a content width larger than the container — so it has nothing to scroll. flexWrap:'wrap' reinforces this by explicitly allowing wrap behaviour.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 7f178466 — fix: fix monorepo (initial import, CommandView introduced in this single commit with flexWrap:wrap and flex:1 already present from the original author's code)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Original design intent was likely to allow the command to wrap gracefully in contexts without a ScrollView (e.g., a plain View container). flex:1 was added to make the command fill the remaining row width after the prompt prefix.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: When CommandView is hosted inside a horizontal ScrollView (as in SidebarBashView and BashViewFull), flex:1 on the Text means it expands to fill the ScrollView's visible width rather than its intrinsic text width. The ScrollView content width = visible width, so no scroll extent is available. flexWrap:wrap then wraps the text at that width, creating the visual overflow symptom.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since initial project import (commit 7f178466, 2026-01-27). SidebarBashView was introduced later (57407902 checkpoint, ~2026-04-06) and inherited the broken behaviour.

evidence.gap: Adding flexWrap:wrap + flex:1 constrains content width to viewport width, making ScrollView contentSize == containerSize, leaving zero scroll extent. Without them, text renders at intrinsic monospace width (often > popup width), giving ScrollView a positive scroll extent.
